'''Krandak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] living during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He studied [[xenobiology]] to know the weaknesses of other [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SW: EOTECR">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
